blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: PII escape
Personal data fenced at the boundary with redaction before any model or analyst sees it.
Silent prompt drift
Prompts versioned and evaluated like code — a change to a prompt is a change to the product.
Ungrounded fluency
Answers require retrievable evidence — fluency without grounding fails the eval and stays off the menu.
